adjust_source_page_audit.finding: Page 3 states more than 112.1 billion app downloads in 2025; the final wording did not invent a geography or category split.
Page 9 qualifies most organizations as low or moderate maturity and attributes efficiency gains over 20% to a small group with advanced deployment.
Page 19 supports global 2024–2025 casino installs +22% and sessions −5%, and slots installs +46% and sessions −5%.
Page 21 supports all-game retention of 27%, 13%, 8% and 5% at days 1, 7, 14 and 30, with minimal year-over-year change.
Pages 27 and 29 support global e-commerce installs −10%, sessions +5%, and the global CPI relationships; the final wording preserved the category and year relationships.
Pages 34 and 36 support finance installs −4%, sessions +21%, session length 7.18 minutes/+8%, and day-0 sessions per user 1.52 to 1.48.
Page 35 supports LATAM installs +76% and sessions +57%; the source does not state counts or denominators, so none were added.
